subject: MAP: hosting runway & geo-gating decision — path to production
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@avahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: hosting runway & geo-gating decision — path to production

Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (RW-AVA-MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out the evaluation checkpoints, decision owners, and a recommended timeline to get a pilot live. High level:

- Objective: Validate inference latency and cost at scale, confirm security posture, and pick hosting mode for production (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Short recommendation: run a short hosted POC for functional validation, then a Dedicated pilot in us-east for performance/cost validation before considering Private in a later phase (if required for isolation/regulatory reasons).

Key asks for this week:
1) Confirm the four decision owners on your side (technical, security, procurement, product).
2) Any mandatory procurement deadlines or PO timing we should align to.
3) Region constraints (are EU data residency or APAC nodes required for phase 1?).

I also included a maturity checklist and a test matrix in the spreadsheet. On security artifacts: SOC 2 report + standard questionnaire responses attached (security_questionnaire_answered.pdf) — we'll surface anything else your InfoSec team needs.

Proposed timeline (week numbers):
- Week 1: onboarding + seeded tests (hosted)
- Week 3: Dedicated pilot (US) run + cost comparison
- Week 6: Go/no-go decision for production and procurement initiation

If this looks reasonable, I can book a 30min MAP walk-through with your team tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW-AVA-MAP_v1.xlsx, security_questionnaire_answered.pdf
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@avahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudOps <cloudops@avahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@avahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting runway & geo-gating decision — path to production

Marcus —

Appreciate the fast follow. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Decision owners: myself (product), Maria Gomez (technical lead), Jordan Reed (InfoSec), and Procurement (procurement@avahealth.com).
- Prefer to avoid EU hosts for phase 1 due to governance; US-only for initial pilot.
- Procurement timeline: finance needs an approved PO by May 20 to make the June cycle — anything after that pushes to July.

Two asks: can you add an explicit performance SLA target to the MAP (p95 generation latency under 250ms for typical clinical prompts) and include a simple cost-per-1M-token estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated? Our CloudOps is copied for sizing.

Happy to do the walk-through tomorrow at 11am PT.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Product Lead, Ava Health

Sam —

Thanks — added the SLA target and a high-level hosted vs dedicated cost estimate into the MAP (sheet: "KeyMetrics"). Quick notes:

- SLA: p95 < 250ms for the 512-token clinical prompt set (measured on dedicated v-hosts); Hosted POC will have slightly higher variance but we expect median within target.
- Cost sketch: Hosted (managed, faster time-to-value) ~ $X / 1M tokens; Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) ~ $Y / 1M tokens depending on committed throughput and quantization. I'll attach a more detailed sensitivity CSV in the follow-up.
- Region: locking to US-only for phase 1 is fine — we recommend us-east primary with fallback to us-west for DR.

Action items I put into the MAP:
- AVA: confirm decision owner contacts (Sam) — due EOD Tue
- Redwood: provide Dedicated pilot cadence and env checklist — due Mon
- AVA/Procurement: confirm PO window — target May 20

I'll run the 11am PT walk-through with Karthik and Lauren. Invite sent.

—Marcus

Attachments: updated RW-AVA-MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@avahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, CloudOps <cloudops@avahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting runway & geo-gating decision — path to production

Quick internal note that I'm dropping into the thread for technical clarifications during the walk-through:

- Dedicated pilot plan (summary): 2x GPU nodes + inference autoscaler, 1 week soak with 1000 QPS synthetic replay of your typical workload. We'll capture p50/p95/p99 and memory/KV cache hit rates.
- Cost sensitivity is attached (dedicated_cost_sensitivity.csv). This shows committed vs burst assumptions — key levers for AVA are quantization (int8) and batching window.
- If procurement needs pricing on a 12-month reserved plan vs month-to-month burst, we'll produce formal numbers by Tue EOD.

Lauren — please prepare the rollout playbook (canary switch, routing fallback to hosted) so AVA has a clear rollback path.

-Karthik

Attachments: dedicated_cost_sensitivity.csv
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@avahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@avahealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting runway & geo-gating decision — path to production

Marcus / Karthik —

Thanks for the updates and the walk-through earlier — that was helpful. Ava's internal decision: we want to proceed with a Dedicated pilot hosted in US (us-east primary) for phase 1. Primary reasons: predictable latency, clearer unit economics for high-volume clinical inference, and procurement prefers committed capacity for budgeting.

Next steps from our side:
- Procurement: sending PO template (PO_template_AVA.docx) and expected dates — procurement@avahealth.com is copied. They will need the final committed capacity number and contract term to approve by May 20.
- Security: Jordan Reed (InfoSec) will run through the attached security questionnaire and follow up if anything else is required.
- Timeline ask: can Redwood turn up the Dedicated pilot (2x nodes) by May 9? That would let us run validation before the PO cutoff.

If you can confirm the May 9 pilot start and provide the committed-capacity pricing options (1, 6, 12-month terms) by Tue EOD, we'll move the PO internally.

—Sam

Attachments: PO_template_AVA.docx
